facts.statement: Brachygnathosuchus is an extinct genus of crocodilian.
facts.quote: Brachygnathosuchus is an extinct genus of crocodilian.

facts.statement: Fossils of Brachygnathosuchus have been found in the Upper Purus River in western Brazil.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found from the Upper Purus River in western Brazil.

facts.statement: The fossils were found in riverbed silt without lithified strata, so they cannot be dated with certainty.
facts.quote: As there were no lithified strata for the original specimen to be correlated with (it was found in the silt of the riverbed), the fossils cannot be dated with any certainty.

facts.statement: Associated fossils suggest Brachygnathosuchus lived during the Pliocene.
facts.quote: partial remains of different organisms found in the vicinity of the specimen, such as a possible Megamys tooth and a humerus of a megalonychine ground sloth, suggest that they were of Pliocene age.

facts.statement: The name Brachygnathosuchus means "short jawed crocodile" and refers to its unusually broad and stout lower jaw.
facts.quote: The name Brachygnathosuchus (Greek for "short jawed crocodile") refers to its characteristically broad, stout mandible, unusual among crocodilians.

facts.statement: The dentary bone of Brachygnathosuchus differs from other crocodilians and was originally thought to resemble a dinosaur bone.
facts.quote: The bone differs from those of other related fossil and modern crocodilians and was originally said to resemble that of a dinosaur.

facts.statement: An associated eroded osteoderm provides evidence for classifying the animal as a crocodilian.
facts.quote: An eroded osteoderm also associated with the specimen provides further evidence for its classification as a crocodilian.

facts.statement: Brachygnathosuchus was described by Mook in 1921.
Brachygnathosuchus belongs to the parent group Crocodylia.
Brachygnathosuchus is classified in the class Reptilia.
Brachygnathosuchus lived between 11.63 and 7.246 million years ago during the Tortonian.
facts.quote: Time range: Tortonian to Tortonian (11.63 to 7.246 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The holotype consists of a partial right ramus of the lower jaw featuring a very large dentary bone.
rejected.quote: The holotype specimen was referred to Crocodilia on the basis of a partial right ramus of the lower jaw consisting of a portion of a very large dentary bone.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'of a partial right ramus of the lower'
